meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 GitHub 通道：agent 会进入 PR 和 issue 的评论线程参与对话，被人 @ 提及后回复；之后这条线程的后续评论它都会跟进。需要另建一个专用机器人 GitHub 账号来收发评论。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 到机器人的 GitHub 用户名时触发；前提是机器人账号已作为协作者、仓库 webhook 已订阅 Issue 评论和 PR 评审评论等事件。

say.text: 帮我在这个仓库上接入 GitHub 通道
say.note: 会复制并注册适配器、装依赖、构建与跑测试

say.text: 这个仓库是私有的，按 public 策略配置
把 github:acme/backend 接到我的 agent group

howto.what_en: Adds a GitHub channel to NanoClaw: the agent joins PR and issue comment threads, replies after being @-mentioned, and then follows up on later comments in that thread. A dedicated GitHub bot account is required to post and receive comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot's GitHub username in a PR or issue comment; requires the bot account as a collaborator and repo webhooks subscribed to issue comments and PR review comments, etc.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel to this repo
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs the dep, builds and tests

say_en.text: This repo is private, use the public policy
Wire github:acme/backend to my agent group
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring, one session per thread
